> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #425 implements the simplified `/add-rubrics` route requested in #424.
- It wires `/add-rubrics` and `agent/add-rubrics` through the existing implementation workflow, using `agent/rubrics` as the proposal PR base.
- The workflow keeps Sepo runtime code on the default branch and runs the agent in a separate rubrics worktree.
- It also adds the dedicated prompt, route metadata, docs, labels, envelope support, and focused tests.

## Review
The overall shape matches the requested narrow plan, but the current head still has a deterministic validation gap before commit/PR creation. That is a blocker because invalid rubric YAML can become a proposal PR if the model exits successfully but validation is not enforced by workflow code.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Add-Rubrics Worktree Is Not Deterministically Validated | BLOCKING | [`agent-implement.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/96fef8d052d5e0f3cebafe05955ed975569da6a5/.github/workflows/agent-implement.yml#L257-L263) points verification at the rubrics worktree, but the verifier never runs rubric schema validation. The composite action validation path is also disabled by `rubrics_mode_override: read-only`. |
| Valid No-Op Add-Rubrics Runs Get Generic Implementation Failure Messaging | WARNING | [`agent-add-rubrics.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/96fef8d052d5e0f3cebafe05955ed975569da6a5/.github/prompts/agent-add-rubrics.md#L52-L53) allows no-op outcomes, but no changes still become the generic implementation `no_changes` message asking users to restate the request. |
| Internal Action Docs Omit `agent_cwd` | WARNING | [`run-agent-task/action.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/96fef8d052d5e0f3cebafe05955ed975569da6a5/.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml#L40-L46) adds `agent_cwd`, but [`internal-actions.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/96fef8d052d5e0f3cebafe05955ed975569da6a5/.agent/docs/usage/internal-actions.md#L14) does not list it. |
| Generic Tracking Issue Metadata Remains A Tradeoff | INFO | Explicit `/add-rubrics` uses the fixed tracking title `Propose rubric updates` in [`triage.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/96fef8d052d5e0f3cebafe05955ed975569da6a5/.agent/src/triage.ts#L247-L255). This diverges from metadata preferences, but it is also consistent with #424’s simplification goal. |

## Progress
- The PR already implements the proposal-only route shape requested in #424 and avoids the larger direct-commit design from earlier attempts.
- Claude judged the architecture mergeable; Codex’s validation blocker is supported by the current workflow because prompt-level validation is not a deterministic gate.
- Rubrics review’s docs and metadata warnings remain current.
- Existing inline comments and review threads were empty before synthesis.
- Posted 2 new inline comments: `.github/workflows/agent-implement.yml` line 262 and `.github/prompts/agent-add-rubrics.md` line 52.
- No inline replies, minimizations, or thread resolutions were performed.

## Issue Details

<details><summary>Add-Rubrics Worktree Is Not Deterministically Validated</summary>

**Cause:** The add-rubrics route forces rubric mode to read-only, so `run-agent-task` never executes its write-mode rubric validation. The later `Verify changes` step runs the generic verifier against `AGENT_WORKTREE`, but `.agent/scripts/post-agent-verify.sh` only checks diff whitespace, workflow YAML, runtime builds, and script tests.

**Candidate solutions:** Add an add-rubrics-specific validation step such as `node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.agent/dist/cli/rubrics/validate.js" --dir "$AGENT_WORKTREE"` before parse/commit, or make `verify.js` run rubric validation when `ROUTE=add-rubrics`. Gate commit and PR creation on that result.

**Comments:** This is not covered by the prompt instruction to validate; the workflow must enforce it deterministically.

</details>

<details><summary>Valid No-Op Add-Rubrics Runs Get Generic Implementation Failure Messaging</summary>

**Cause:** The prompt allows empty `commit_message`, `pr_title`, and `pr_body` when no rubric change is warranted. If the agent also makes no edits, `determineRunStatus` returns `no_changes`, and `formatImplementComment` emits implementation-specific retry guidance.

**Candidate solutions:** Add route-specific add-rubrics no-change messaging, or treat an explained add-rubrics no-op as a successful terminal result.

**Comments:** This is user-facing polish, not the merge blocker.

</details>

<details><summary>Internal Action Docs Omit `agent_cwd`</summary>

**Cause:** The composite action contract gained `agent_cwd`, but the internal action docs’ input list was not updated.

**Candidate solutions:** Add `agent_cwd` to the documented `run-agent-task` inputs and briefly describe that it runs the model process in an alternate worktree.

</details>

<details><summary>Generic Tracking Issue Metadata Remains A Tradeoff</summary>

**Cause:** Explicit `/add-rubrics` uses a fixed tracking issue title and fallback body rather than the heavier metadata synthesis path used by explicit `/implement`.

**Candidate solutions:** Either accept this as a simplification tradeoff, or reuse a lightweight metadata synthesis path for non-issue add-rubrics requests.

**Comments:** I would not block on this because the source request remains in the issue body and generated PR metadata is still model-provided.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: the validation blocker and small concrete warning fixes are safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
NEEDS_REWORK

## Action Items
- [ ] Gate add-rubrics commit and PR creation on deterministic rubric schema validation against `AGENT_WORKTREE`.
- [ ] Add route-specific handling for explained add-rubrics no-op outcomes.
- [ ] Document the new `agent_cwd` input for `run-agent-task`.
